name: Media Downloader
description: Save a YouTube video or just the sound for later. Paste a Spotify song and we will find the sound for you, title and cover kept tidy.
details:
Paste a YouTube URL, luma fetches the video's title, thumbnail, and duration, then lets you choose exactly what to download:

- Video (MP4) at any available resolution, up to the source's best quality
- Audio only, as MP3, M4A, or Opus, at a bitrate you choose (96–320 kbps)

Paste a Spotify track link instead and luma reads its title, artist, and cover art from Spotify's public track page — no account or API key needed — then searches YouTube for the matching audio and downloads it, tagged with the real metadata and cover art. Spotify's own streams are DRM-protected, so this never touches them directly; playlists and albums aren't supported yet, only single tracks.

Downloads run through a locally managed copy of yt-dlp and ffmpeg (fetched automatically on first use, kept in luma's app data folder — nothing is bundled into the app itself). Progress, speed, and ETA are shown live, and every completed download is kept in a history list so you can jump straight to the file.
